Join us in building the future of finance.

Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

About the team + role

We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. 

Bitstamp Europe S.A. is Robinhood’s EU-regulated crypto exchange and the company’s primary licensing hub for European operations. Under Robinhood, Bitstamp Europe is the cornerstone of the company’s ambition to become Europe’s leading regulated crypto platform - serving institutional, retail and B2B clients through spot, perpetual futures, and crypto-as-a-service offerings.

As President, Bitstamp Europe, you will serve as the general manager and senior-most leader of Bitstamp Europe S.A., with full P&L accountability for Robinhood’s European crypto business. You will be the company’s most senior face to European regulators - primarily the CSSF in Luxembourg, with whom you are expected to qualify as an Authorized Manager and to institutional partners, counterparties, and key stakeholders across the region. This is a high-visibility, externally facing leadership role requiring equal mastery of financial regulation, business strategy, and team leadership.

This role is based in our Luxembourg office, with in-person attendance expected 5 days per week.

At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams. 

What you’ll do

  • Serve as the CSSF-recognized Authorized Manager and primary regulatory representative for Bitstamp Europe's MiCA CASP, Payment Institution and related licenses across all business lines.
  • Lead supervisory engagement on examinations, license conditions, notifications, outsourcing and regulatory change. 
  • Clear new products and markets for launch quickly, so regulation speeds up revenue growth.
  • Own the P&L of Bitstamp Europe S.A. and be accountable for revenue growth across institutional and B2B in the EEA. Drive volume, fee yield and market share, and keep the cost base disciplined as revenue scales.
  • Define and execute Bitstamp Europe’s regional go-to-market strategy in close partnership with Robinhood’s global product, engineering, compliance, and BD leadership
  • Lead, grow, and develop the Luxembourg-based team - recruit senior talent, define organizational structure, and preserve Bitstamp’s culture of performance and integrity 
  • Own institutional and strategic partnership relationships across Europe, including B2B crypto-as-a-service clients, bank liquidity partnerships, and key institutional accounts
  • Proactively navigate the evolving European regulatory landscape - MiCA, MiFID II, DORA, and future frameworks - ensuring sustained CSSF compliance and shaping regulatory engagements

What you bring

  • Significant experience in regulated financial services with meaningful European presence - ideally combining fintech or crypto depth with deep working knowledge of Luxembourg or EU financial regulation
  • Demonstrated experience qualifying or operating as an Approved Person or Authorized Manager under European regulatory frameworks (CSSF, FCA, DNB, BaFin, or equivalent); ability to qualify as a CSSF Authorized Manager is required
  • Deep command of MiCA, MiFID II, and the CSSF’s regulatory expectations for crypto-asset service providers; working knowledge of DORA, AML/CFT frameworks, and PSD2
  • P&L ownership at scale in a regulated European financial entity - you have run a business, not just managed a function
  • Proven track record building and closing institutional B2B relationships and strategic partnerships in European financial markets
  • Experience leading through corporate integration or significant organizational change - managing competing stakeholders while keeping a business performing
  • Fluency in English required; French or Luxembourgish a plus

Leadership expectations 

Our ambitious roadmap requires a great culture shaped by exceptional leaders. Here’s what we expect from them:

  • Drive high performance by setting clear, focused goals, giving real-time feedback, stretching top talent, and scaling impact through focus, innovation, and tech.
  • Hire and retain top talent by setting a high bar, hiring only those who raise it, investing in onboarding, and addressing talent issues quickly and fairly.
  • Create community by connecting work to purpose, removing friction while prioritizing safety, building trust and inclusion, and leading from the front with integrity.

What we offer

  • Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career.
  • Performance-driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching.
  • Best-in-class benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents.
  • Lifestyle wallet - a highly flexible benefits spending account for wellness, learning, and more.
  • Employer-paid life & disability insurance, fertility benefits, and mental health benefits.
  • Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more!
  • Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces.

Click here to learn more about our Total Rewards, which vary by region and entity.

If our mission energizes you and you’re ready to build the future of finance, we look forward to seeing your application.

Lightspark is creating the Money Grid, modern, open financial infrastructure that makes payments accessible, affordable, and instant for businesses and users worldwide. We're challenging the status quo, updating the current system, and empowering our partners to build better solutions. Together, we're building the most advanced financial infrastructure, open, instant, and global, inspiring a future where anyone, anywhere can access the full potential of digital money.

This role sits within Lightspark’s European operations, based in Tallinn, Estonia. Following Lightspark’s acquisition of Striga, we’re building Lightspark’s European payments platform, connecting fiat and crypto rails to enable faster, more efficient money movement across borders.

We’re looking for a hands-on Information Security Manager to help establish and maintain our security and compliance framework in Europe, ensuring readiness for Estonian and EU regulatory requirements (e.g., DORA, ISO27001). This role balances technical execution, ICT risk management, and regulatory governance, partnering closely with our engineering team, as well as U.S. and EU-based advisors, to build a scalable and compliant security posture.

You’ll be both a builder and an operator: implementing controls, hardening systems, managing risk, and ensuring the company’s security measures enable growth while meeting regulatory expectations.

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING:

  • Drive security strategy and governance: Develop, implement, and monitor a comprehensive information security and ICT risk management program aligned with DORA, ISO27001, and EU/Estonian requirements.

  • Develop and maintain frameworks: Own the company’s Information Security Management System (ISMS), ensuring all policies, controls, and documentation align with regulatory and business needs.

  • Implement and operate security controls: Deploy and manage technical safeguards across cloud, on-prem, and application environments, covering vulnerability management, system hardening, and incident response.

  • Collaborate across teams: Work closely with Lightspark’s global engineering, risk, and compliance functions to ensure consistent application of security standards and processes across systems and services.

  • Lead ICT risk management: Identify, assess, and manage ICT risks across business units, and provide actionable security insights for new technologies and initiatives.

  • Engage with regulators and auditors: Serve as the main point of contact (or in coordination with control functions) for regulators, auditors, and external security assessors.

  • Measure and report security posture: Regularly brief management and, where applicable, the Supervisory Board on key risks, compliance status, and improvement initiatives.

  • Promote a culture of security: Drive employee awareness and training programs to foster security ownership and operational hygiene across the company.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR:

  • 5+ years in information security operations or management with proven implementation of security and compliance programs. Experience in ICT risk management and oversight of technical security functions.

  • Strong understanding of EU/Estonian frameworks, including DORA, ISO27001, SOC2, and GDPR. Experience supporting regulatory licensing or audit processes is a plus.

  • Hands-on experience with cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP), secure configuration, vulnerability management, monitoring, and incident response. Strong understanding of security engineering practices and familiarity with Linux/Windows hardening, networking, and scripting (e.g., Python, Bash).

  • Higher education in a STEM or business-related field.

  • Full working proficiency in English and Estonian.

  • Proactive, structured, and detail-oriented leader with strong project management, communication, and collaboration skills.

  • Experience preparing for regulatory inspections, working with ISO27001 audits, or partnering with fractional CISO/DPO roles. Certifications such as CISSP, CISM, ISO27001 Lead Implementer, or CIPP/E are beneficial.

  • This role is based in our Tallinn, Estonia office and requires regular in-office presence.

COMPENSATION

The gross monthly base salary range for this role is €4,840 – €5,680. The final offer will depend on experience and skills, and is determined using objective, gender-neutral criteria. You will also be eligible for an annual performance bonus and equity.

 

Lightspark is on a mission to build the future of open, instant, and global financial infrastructure making payments accessible and affordable for everyone, everywhere. We're committed to creating a more inclusive and diverse workplace to reflect the customers we serve. We welcome interest from individuals of all backgrounds and levels of experience who share our mission. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

 

For US Applicants:

We will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of the State of California Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring.

About Blackbird:

Blackbird Labs is a loyalty and payments platform establishing meaningful connections between the world’s best restaurants and their customers.

Served up in 2022 by Ben Leventhal, co-founder of Eater and Resy, Blackbird offers a fully customizable loyalty programming platform for restaurants and a consumer app designed to make every guest feel like a bonafide VIP no matter where they dine. Backed by Union Square Ventures, a16z, Amex Ventures, Variant Fund, and other forward-thinking investors, Blackbird is out to revolutionize the restaurant industry.

About Our Team:

At Blackbird, our values guide everything we do and our talent principles define the key traits we seek in our employees.

We have passion for our product – committed to our mission and instinctively think like and go the extra mile for our customers. We are elite performers – striving for excellence, going above and beyond to achieve exceptional results, and learning quickly with horsepower, drive, and grit. We make others better – taking initiative to elevate others, giving and receiving feedback, and championing a culture of growth. We hold one another accountable to living out our talent principles as we march together to achieving our mission.

About the Role

The Restaurant Success Manager is the connective tissue between Blackbird and the existing restaurants in its managed network. You will own a defined book of restaurant partners, drive TPV growth across that book, and ensure each restaurant is getting meaningful value out of the Blackbird platform.

This role sits at the intersection of relationship management and field operations. A significant portion of your book will consist of restaurants that have been on the platform but have not yet been actively managed. Your job is to change that. You will build real working relationships with operators, run activations that drive guest engagement, and keep Blackbird top of mind on the floor and behind the bar.

The right person for this role is energetic, organized, and genuinely enjoys spending time in restaurants. You are as comfortable walking into a busy kitchen at 4pm as you are building a quarterly account plan at your desk.

 
 

Responsibilities

Book Management and TPV Growth

  • Own a defined book of 100+ restaurant partners and drive QoQ TPV growth across that book

  • Conduct regular account check-ins with GMs, owners, and front-of-house managers to assess engagement with Blackbird, surface friction, and identify growth opportunities

  • Identify and reactivate dormant or under-engaged partners within your assigned book

  • Develop and execute account-level activation plans in coordination with the Restaurant Experience team

  • Monitor TPV performance across your book on a regular cadence and escalate accounts showing significant decline

  • Drive restaurant-side $FLY loading by selling $FLY to partners interested in running activations on the platform

  • Drive adoption of Blackbird’s events and PDR tool as well as any forthcoming Flynet apps

New logo acquisition

  • Depending on the market, RSMs will either be responsible for signing 1 and 2 location QSRs only, FSR & 1 or 2 location QSRs, or will not have any logo acquisition responsibilities.

Field Operations and Activation

  • Run $FLYback & bespoke activations and in-restaurant promotions in coordination with partners, managing logistics from planning through execution

  • Serve as the on-the-ground presence for Blackbird in your market, maintaining regular in-person contact with partner restaurants

  • Support restaurant staff with platform education and product familiarity as needed, ensuring the team on the floor understands and can speak to their guests about Blackbird

  • Represent Blackbird at local dining events, industry gatherings, and market activations where appropriate

Operational Support

  • Triage and resolve tier 2 operational questions and issues from your book, when escalation from our partner support team is needed.

  • Depending on the market, liaise with Field Operations to resolve any hardware issues that partners may encounter

  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date account records in HubSpot, Metabase, and owned Blackbird Restaurant team tooling including activity logs, engagement notes, and TPV tracking

  • Communicate clearly and consistently with your manager on book health, risks, and opportunities

What We're Looking For

  • 2 or more years of experience in account management, hospitality, or a customer-facing commercial role

  • A genuine affinity for restaurants and the local dining scene in your market

  • Strong interpersonal skills — you build trust quickly with operators, GMs, and ownership groups

  • Organized and reliable: you manage a high volume of relationships without letting things fall through the cracks

  • Comfortable working in the field. A meaningful portion of this role is in-restaurant, not at a desk

  • Familiarity with CRM tools (HubSpot preferred) and basic commercial reporting

  • Ability to operate independently while staying aligned with team priorities and manager direction

  • Based in the market you support (New York City or Charleston, SC). Significant in-market travel is required

 

Pay Transparency Notice & Benefits

Depending on your work location and experience the target annual salary for this position can range from: $80k - $150k USD. This range does not include the equity component of the overall compensation package. Disclosure in accordance with New York City's Pay Transparency Law.

Full time offers from Blackbird may also include stock options, benefits (including medical, dental, vision, flexible time off, 401(k)), and some not-so-standard, extra-fun perks (quarterly budget for Blackbird testing, anniversary travel, annual learning and development stipend) — subject to applicable taxes and based on eligibility.

Commitment to Equal Opportunity

Onboarding Analyst

About Dakota

Dakota is a stablecoin infrastructure platform powering modern financial products through regulated money movement, stablecoin orchestration, and cross-border settlement. We serve institutional clients — fintechs, payment service providers, marketplaces, and enterprises — through an API-first platform that abstracts the complexity of custody, compliance, settlement, and banking partnerships.

 

We are a remote-first team across North America and Europe. We value high-quality work, clear thinking, and ownership.

 
 

The Role

We are seeking an Onboarding Analyst to join our compliance team and support the onboarding of both institutional and consumer clients. You will conduct KYC, KYB, and due diligence reviews end to end, serve as a point of contact for client CIP questions, and partner with the Compliance Manager to refine workflows. The goal is to keep onboarding efficient, accurate, and fully compliant with global AML/CTF requirements while delivering a smooth client experience.

 
 

What You'll Do

  • Own the onboarding lifecycle: Manage the intake, review, and timely resolution of onboarding and inbound KYC/KYB requests from institutional and consumer clients.

  • Onboard institutional clients: Review entity documentation, including formation documents, ownership and control structures, and ultimate beneficial owner (UBO) information for businesses, funds, and other legal entities.

  • Onboard consumer clients: Collect and verify identity documentation and complete customer due diligence (CDD) for individual applicants.

  • Conduct screening and enhanced due diligence: Perform PEP, sanctions, and adverse media screening, and complete enhanced due diligence (EDD) where required.

  • Assess and escalate risk: Evaluate client risk profiles, determine when documentation does not meet the standard, and escalate high-risk cases to the Compliance Manager.

  • Support ongoing monitoring: Assist with periodic client reviews, reporting, regulatory filings, and ad-hoc compliance initiatives.

 
 

What We're Looking For

  • 2 or more years of experience in KYC/KYB, AML, compliance, or client onboarding at a fintech, payments, crypto, or financial services company.

  • Working knowledge of global AML/CTF requirements, FATF standards, and CIP best practices for both institutional entities and individuals, with the ability to apply them in practice.

  • Familiarity with onboarding/AML platforms, identity verification tools, and screening databases.

  • Strong attention to detail and organization, including under high volume and tight deadlines, and comfort handling sensitive client data.

  • Clear, confident written and verbal communication with clients, senior stakeholders, and internal teams, and sound judgment on when to resolve versus escalate.

  • A proactive, self-directed approach and the ability to adapt in a fast-moving environment.

  • A genuine interest in building a career in AML/CFT compliance.

 
 

How We Work

At Dakota, we value people who:

  • Strive for excellence

  • Practice extreme ownership

  • Experiment fearlessly and learn quickly

  • Stay close to customers

  • Communicate clearly and directly

 
 

What We Offer

  • Engaging problems that increase economic freedom globally

  • Competitive salary and equity

  • Employee-friendly equity terms (extended exercise)

  • Remote work (no commuting to the office)

  • Paid co-working space/desk at an office

  • Health, dental, and vision insurance

  • Regular team events and off-sites

TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. The impact you'll have

You're accountable for what your team ships and for the caliber of the PMs who ship it.

You'll own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for TRM's Onchain Compliance products, serving financial institutions, fintechs, crypto businesses, and regulators, and the outcomes your team delivers: adoption, retention, and ARR.

  • Leading: Hire, coach, and develop PMs. Give direct feedback, know each PM's growth areas, and step in early when a PM or project starts to slip.

What we're looking for

Core product skills

  • Product ownership: You own outcomes, not coordination. You've taken complex enterprise products from discovery through launch to measurable business impact.

  • AI-native execution: You already build agents and use AI to accelerate your work and your team's. You can demo it.

  • Bias for action: You make decisions with incomplete information and ship working solutions in days, not weeks.

  • Product taste: You know what great looks like, and you make opinionated calls on what to build, what to cut, and when to ship.

Leadership skills

  • People leadership: You've built and grown a team of PMs, not just inherited one. You can point to a PM whose performance changed because of something you did.

  • Vision and communication: You simplify complex ideas, align teams around what matters, and inspire others to build toward a shared vision.

  • Cross-team influence: You set expectations and unblock work with PMs and teams outside your own.

  • Additionally, this role may be eligible to participate in TRM’s equity plan.

Application Instructions

Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your skills and qualifications for the role.

If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure your application will be considered.

Interviewing with TRM

Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while allowing you to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, an AI skills assessment, and a Leadership Principles interview.

  • Recruiter Intro: Qualifications, motivations, and alignment with the role.

  • Welcome to TRM: We're excited to build a safer world with you!

Your recruiter will share your specific interview plan and preparation guidance along the way.

AI Fluency at TRM

AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM.

We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks.

At TRM, AI fluency means you are among the top 10 percent of operators in your function in how you apply AI to:

  • Accelerate repeatable workflows

  • Structure and solve problems

  • Improve output quality

  • Increase speed and leverage

You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process.

Life at TRM

We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day.

TRM moves FAST. We are a high-velocity, high-ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days.

Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving.

At TRM, you should expect:

  • Priorities and targets to change quickly

  • Operating with a high degree of ambiguity

  • A high level of personal ownership and accountability

  • Close collaboration across teams and functions

  • Frequent, high-touch communication

  • Creative problem-solving and out-of-the-box thinking

  • A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes

This environment is energizing for people who enjoy building, solving hard problems, and making progress in situations that are not always fully defined. It also requires thriving in ambiguity, adjusting course as new information emerges, and maintaining focus and positivity in a fast-moving and intense environment.

We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone. If you are primarily optimizing for predictability or a consistently balanced workload, we encourage you to use the interview process to pressure-test whether this environment is truly the right fit. We want teammates who thrive here, not just survive here.

If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute.

Leadership Principles

  • Impact-Oriented Trailblazer: We put customers first and move with speed, focus, and adaptability. We treat every plan like an experiment – test, ship, measure, and iterate quickly.

  • Master Craftsperson: We care deeply about our craft. We balance speed with high standards, own outcomes end‑to‑end, and invest in getting better everyday.

  • Inspiring Colleague: We add clarity and energy, not noise. We bring humility, candor, and a one‑team mindset — giving and receiving feedback to make the team stronger.

Join our Mission

Own Your Intelligence

 

Prime Intellect is building the open superintelligence stack: the infrastructure frontier AI labs build internally, made available to every ambitious AI team.

 

Our platform, Lab, unifies compute, environments, evaluations, secure sandboxes, high-performance training, and deployment into one full-stack system for post-training at frontier scale - from SFT and RL to tool use, agent workflows, and continuously improving production models. We are building open frontier AI: open-source models trained end to end for long-horizon tasks like autonomous research, and the full-stack platform our own research team uses to build them. The next generation of AI companies, enterprises, and research teams do not just need more GPUs. They need the ability to turn their own workflows, tools, data, and feedback loops into superintelligence they own.

 

Prime Intellect has raised $150M in total funding from Founders Fund, Radical Ventures, NVIDIA, and exceptional AI, infrastructure, and enterprise operators — including Andrej Karpathy, Dwarkesh Patel, and leaders and founders from Ramp, Perplexity, Harvey, Mercor, Zapier, Datadog, Cognition, OpenAI, Thinking Machines, Together AI, SemiAnalysis, LangChain, Browserbase, Cloudflare, Sierra, Databricks, Airbnb, OpenRouter, Standard Intelligence, Fleet, Core Auto, and more. We are looking for people who want to build at the intersection of frontier research, real infrastructure, and go-to-market for a category that does not fully exist yet.

Role Impact

You will own applied RL programs from the first ambiguous customer problem through a deployed improvement loop. You will understand the workflow and business stakes, decide what can be measured and learned, build the environment and evaluation, run post-training experiments, deploy the result, and determine what should generalize into Prime's shared stack. The majority of your work will be organized around external programs. You will work directly with customer researchers, engineers, and leaders, and you will be accountable for both the research result and its practical impact.

Responsibilities

Applied Research at Prime

We turn a workflow into tasks, environments, evaluations, and reward signals, run post-training experiments against real baselines, and deploy what works. When a result looks good, we find out whether the gain came from the model or from the data, harness, inference, or infrastructure. The reusable parts become shared research, open-source systems, and product capabilities.

Every Applied Research role is externally facing. Most researchers work directly with customers, users, or research partners while maintaining a substantive research agenda.

Role scope

We have active programs across technology, science, engineering, regulated industries, and the public sector.

Representative early problems

  • Turn a partially documented workflow and business goal into an environment, baseline, and evaluation that the customer team agrees measures the right outcome.

  • Improve a domain agent through RL or another post-training method while separating model limitations from task, harness, inference, and integration failures.

  • Carry a successful experiment into deployment, measure its effect on the customer outcome, and convert the recurring parts into reusable environments, recipes, data loops, or platform capabilities.

What you will own

  • Technical and business discovery that produces a clear research plan, success measure, environment, and baseline.

  • RL, distillation, and other post-training experiments tied to deployment outcomes.

  • Agent systems that handle tool use, memory, recovery, long horizons, and human oversight.

  • Deployment and adoption decisions, plus reusable artifacts carried back to Prime's research, engineering, and product teams.

Requirements

  • Relevant experience: customer-embedded technical work, research engineering, technical founding experience, applied ML consulting with real build ownership, or end-to-end post-training programs.

  • You should be comfortable with senior external teams and able to connect experimental evidence to business decisions without lowering the research bar.

  • Hands-on experience building and debugging model-training, post-training, agent, evaluation, or closely adjacent experimental loops.

  • Strong experimental judgment: meaningful baselines, careful trace inspection, clear failure attribution, and a willingness to change direction when the evidence changes.

  • Strong Python and the ability to build artifacts that other researchers and engineers can run, inspect, and extend.

  • Comfort owning ambiguous problems and keeping partners and teammates current as you resolve them.

Evidence of exceptional work

We value publications, open-source systems, benchmarks, and shipped products as evidence of exceptional work. Show us something difficult you built, what failed, and how the evidence changed your approach.

Benefits and Perks

  • Cash Compensation Range of $150-300k + equity incentives

  • Flexible Work (San Francisco, New York, London, or remote)

  • Visa Sponsorship & relocation support

  • Professional Development budget

  • Team Off-sites & conference attendance

If you're excited about the opportunity to build the foundation for the future of decentralized AI and create a platform that empowers developers and researchers to push the boundaries of what's possible, we'd love to hear from you.
